title: Koi Tay Mera Asghar Menu Mor Leya Day
body:
Rondi Rubab Koi Mera Laal Mila Day
<<DIVIDER>>
Gaya Pyasa Mera Asghar Oday Baad Milaya Panee
Akhay Sakina Koi Karay Itni Mehrbaani
Mere Hisay Da Panee Koi Ohdi Qabar Thay Paa Day
<<DIVIDER>>
Sehravan Di Garmi Day Qabil Nai Laal Mera
Haey Pyaseyan Labaan Tay Ghazi Hay Naam Tera
Tin Din Da Ey Pyaasa Ehdi Pyaas Bujha Day
<<DIVIDER>>
Her Behn Vich Madinay Veeran Nou Paee Khadaaway
Beemar Sughra Ro Ro Asghar Nou Paee Bulaway
Ohday Vayn Mustafa Day Rozay Nu Hila Day
<<DIVIDER>>
Akhay Zahra Mein Baqiyay Vich Lay Javan Tera Asghar
Shabeer Phul Ey Nazuk Duniya Bari Sitamgar
Ehdi Laash Tay Vee Zalim Ghoray Na Dora Day
<<DIVIDER>>
Jaway Putar Pyasaa Tay Maan Panee Kiwain Piway
Dayway Jawab Koi Maan Ujree Kiwain Jeeway
Jis Maan Da Laal Zalim Naizay Thay Charha Day
